name: pinflower
description: Order bouquets from independent Prague florists: live prices, delivery times, pay on pinflower.cz.

interface.longDescription:
Pinflower lets you order a bouquet from independent florist studios in Prague, Czech Republic, right in the chat.

What you can do:
- Find bouquets by occasion, budget, style, district or address, date and a deliver-by time.
- See real bouquets with live prices in CZK, what is inside and the exact delivery or pickup times.
- Check whether and when a studio can deliver to a Prague address, district or quarter, and what delivery costs.
- Get the exact total before ordering, with the terms link, then place the order after you confirm.
- Pay on pinflower.cz through a secure link (card, Apple Pay, Google Pay). The amount is only held until the florist hands the bouquet over.
- Check an order's status, get a new payment link, or cancel an unpaid order.

Who it is for: people in Prague and people abroad sending flowers to someone in Prague — in Czech, English, Russian or Ukrainian.

Limits: delivery only within Prague (or pickup at the studio in Prague). Payment is never taken inside ChatGPT; the plugin does not see card details. Prices, stock and times come live from the florists' own shop pages on pinflower.cz.
capabilities: Find bouquets from Prague florists by occasion, budget and time
Check delivery to a Prague address or pickup
Price the order exactly before you confirm
Place the order and get a payment link on pinflower.cz
Track, re-send the payment link or cancel an order
defaultPrompt: Send red roses to Vinohrady today, up to 1 500 Kč
Birthday bouquet delivered in Prague tomorrow before 5 pm
I'm abroad: flowers to Prague 6 tonight?

positive.description: Same-day delivery search with budget and district
positive.prompt: Send red roses to my mum in Vinohrady today, up to 1 500 Kč.
positive.expected_behavior: Shows real bouquets under 1 500 Kč that can still be delivered to Vinohrady today, with prices and times; no invented items.

positive.description: Czech birthday request with a deliver-by time
positive.prompt: Kytici k narozeninám na Smíchov zítra do 17:00.
positive.expected_behavior: Answers in Czech with birthday bouquets that arrive in Smíchov tomorrow before 17:00.

positive.prompt: I'm abroad — can you get flowers delivered to Prague 6 tonight?
positive.expected_behavior: Confirms tonight's delivery options to Prague 6 with real times and prices, and explains payment happens on pinflower.cz.

positive.prompt: Do you deliver to Letňany and how much does it cost?
positive.expected_behavior: States whether delivery to Letňany is available, the delivery fee and earliest time, without inventing numbers.

positive.prompt: How do you charge my card, and what if nobody is home?
positive.expected_behavior: Explains the card hold until handover, payment on pinflower.cz and what happens if the recipient is not at home.

negative.description: Plant care question unrelated to ordering
negative.prompt: How do I keep cut tulips fresh longer?
Write me a poem for Mother's Day.
What will the weather be in Prague tomorrow?

review.commerce_description: Physical goods: fresh bouquets from independent florist studios in Prague. Checkout is external: the plugin returns a payment link to pinflower.cz (Stripe); no card data passes through ChatGPT.

publication.release_notes: Tool annotations corrected per review: every tool sets readOnlyHint, destructiveHint, idempotentHint and openWorldHint explicitly. Address lookups (search, bouquet details, delivery check, quote) are openWorld; order, payment link and cancel are destructive, open-world writes; cancel is not idempotent. Read tools no longer start background translation or write data.
